name: LABUBU Token
fix_description: In _transfer, when sender balance reaches 0, it is forcibly set to 16 (creating tokens from nothing). Attacker repeatedly transfers full balance, getting 16 free tokens each time. Fix: remove the if(_balances[sender] == 0) { _balances[sender] = 16; } logic entirely.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-core-idea exploit: abuse a token’s flawed transfer logic during a PancakeV3 flash callback to multiply LABUBU balance, then dump it through standard routers. It requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning beyond understanding a flash loan callback and simple token swapping, and the PoC is well under 100 lines of real exploit logic.
